create_output_hook_context: create an OutputHook context manager to capture layer outputs from a PyTorch module during forward pass
register_forward_hooks: register forward hooks on named layers of a PyTorch module to capture intermediate outputs
remove_registered_hooks: remove all registered forward hooks from the OutputHook to free resources
rgetattr_nested_attribute: recursively get a nested attribute from a PyTorch module using dot-separated path strings
capture_outputs_as_tensor: capture layer outputs as tensors instead of numpy arrays by setting as_tensor to True
